I joined over 100 Republican lawmakers to file an amicus brief with the Supreme Court.

We are supporting pro-life efforts to protect women and unborn children from deadly mail-order chemical abortions.

Mifepristone and other abortion drugs put women’s lives at risk. They kill kids.

By preventing access to mail-order chemical abortion drugs, we can restore safeguards that prevent coercion, keep women safe, and protect innocent life.

As Senator, I’m proud to fight for life.

Thank you for your bravery and service.

It was great to attend the Nebraska Bankers Association Annual Convention in La Vista yesterday.  I shared how Senate Banking Committee is fighting to make housing more affordable for Nebraskans.

We discussed how cutting through red tape and regulations helps all Nebraskans. Thank you for having me!

The Working Families Tax Cuts are delivering for Nebraska’s small businesses.

Small businesses are critical to the economic vitality of communities across Nebraska. They are now receiving historic tax relief.

With the Working Families Tax Cuts, we are encouraging businesses to invest in research or expand manufacturing.

We made Senator Deb Fischer’s Paid Family and Medical Leave Tax Credit permanent.  This allows businesses to provide more paid family leave for new kids.  We also made it more

Today, I toured Case New Holland’s Industrial Facility in Grand Island.
 
Their AF Series Combine was voted “Coolest Thing Made in Nebraska”—and it is cool!
 
I was able to share how the Working Families Tax Cuts helps Nebraska workers and businesses.

Great to meet with law enforcement in Grand Island today! I toured the newly expanded Nebraska Law Enforcement Training Center (NLETC). When I was Governor, we invested nearly $50 million to make this center state-of-the-art.

The NLETC trains NSP Troopers, veteran police officers, and cadets beginning their careers. It’s the largest training academy in Nebraska.
 
I will always fight to support our heroic law enforcement officers!
Today is National Day of Prayer. May the peace, strength, and wisdom prayer brings guide us not just today on #NationalDayofPrayer, but every day.

Yesterday, I visited farmers and ranchers to share how I’m working with @USDA to strengthen Nebraska ag.

Under Secretary Fordyce came to Nebraska and joined me.

We showed the USDA what every Nebraskan knows: our farmers and ranchers are the best in the world.

Yesterday, I was joined by Under Secretary Fordyce at a roundtable with farmers, ranchers, and ag leaders from across the state.
 
Secretary Fordyce and I discussed how investments from the Working Families Tax Cuts are supporting Nebraska ag. We highlighted @USDA programs for farm credit, risk management, and wildlife recovery.
